summary: This contract outlines the terms for a software subscription and services agreement between Red Oak Analytics, Inc. and Northwind Retail Ltd., including definitions, services provided, customer obligations, term and renewal, fees and payment, and customer data and security.

clauses.text: 4.1 This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and will remain in effect for an initial term of thirty-six (36) months, unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Agreement.
clauses.risk_reason: Specifies the initial term and conditions for renewal or termination of the agreement.
clauses.evidence_text: This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and will remain in effect for an initial term of thirty-six (36) months, unless earlier terminated in accordance with this Agreement.
clauses.explanation: This clause sets the duration of the agreement and the conditions under which it can be terminated, which is important for both parties to understand their ongoing obligations and the potential for early termination.

clauses.text: 4.2 Upon expiration of the initial term, this Agreement will automatically renew for successive renewal terms of twelve (12) months each unless Customer delivers written notice of non-renewal to Supplier at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. 5. Fees and Payment
clauses.risk_reason: Details the automatic renewal terms and the requirement for written notice of non-renewal.
clauses.evidence_text: Upon expiration of the initial term, this Agreement will automatically renew for successive renewal terms of twelve (12) months each unless Customer delivers written notice of non-renewal to Supplier at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term.
clauses.explanation: This clause affects the continuity of service and payment obligations, requiring careful attention to avoid unintended renewals or terminations.

clauses.text: 5.1 Customer will pay the fees set out in the applicable Order Form. Except as expressly stated otherwise, all fees are non- cancellable and non-refundable.
clauses.risk_reason: Incorrectly flagged as confidentiality; actually pertains to payment terms.
clauses.evidence_text: Customer will pay the fees set out in the applicable Order Form. Except as expressly stated otherwise, all fees are non- cancellable and non-refundable.
clauses.explanation: This clause should be reviewed for its actual impact on payment terms rather than confidentiality, as it outlines the non-cancellable and non-refundable nature of fees.

clauses.text: 5.2 Supplier may invoice subscription fees annually in advance and Professional Services fees monthly in arrears. Any undisputed amount not paid when due will accrue interest at the lesser of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, plus reasonable collection costs.
clauses.risk_reason: Specifies invoicing and payment terms, including interest on late payments.
clauses.evidence_text: Supplier may invoice subscription fees annually in advance and Professional Services fees monthly in arrears. Any undisputed amount not paid when due will accrue interest at the lesser of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month or the maximum rate permitted by law, plus reasonable collection costs.
clauses.explanation: This clause is critical for understanding the financial obligations and potential penalties for late payments, affecting cash flow and financial planning.

clauses.text: 5.3 Supplier may increase recurring subscription fees once in any twelve (12) month period upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Customer. Any increase to recurring fees for the same Services during the then-current term will not exceed nine percent (9%), except to reflect changes in taxes, third-party pass-through costs, or Customer's usage levels. Continued access to or use of the Services after the effective date of the revised pricing will constitute Customer's acceptance of the revised fees.
clauses.risk_reason: Allows for fee increases under certain conditions.
clauses.evidence_text: Supplier may increase recurring subscription fees once in any twelve (12) month period upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Customer. Any increase to recurring fees for the same Services during the then-current term will not exceed nine percent (9%), except to reflect changes in taxes, third-party pass-through costs, or Customer's usage levels.
clauses.explanation: This clause impacts the budget for the services and should be reviewed to understand the limits and conditions under which fees can be increased.

clauses.text: 5.4 Fees are exclusive of taxes, duties, levies, or similar governmental assessments, all of which will be paid by Customer, excluding taxes based on Supplier's net income. 6. Customer Data and Security
clauses.risk_reason: Clarifies that fees are exclusive of certain taxes and duties.

clauses.explanation: This clause is important for budgeting and financial planning, as it clarifies the customer's responsibility for certain taxes and duties.
